scope: Sheets filter choices reflect saved conditions and other columns while retaining the selected column value exclusions.
changes: Read-only authenticated Sheets UI endpoint derives choices from the persisted native filter and formatted cell values.
Keep conditions staged until OK; reopening a saved filter recomputes its choices.
Search counts and select-all counts update for the displayed choices.

tests.contract_matrix: All four layers passed across Docs, Drive and Sheets with zero findings and zero unexpected 5xx.

flows: Initial five values; unsaved >=20 retains five; save and reopen yields 20/30/40.
Exclude 40 and Closed; reopening C shows 20 checked and 40 unchecked, with 30 absent.
Stage >=35, search 4, Select all 1, Cancel and mobile reload preserve saved >=20 and excluded 40.
Mobile dialog fits within 390px with no page overflow; desktop and mobile screenshots inspected transiently.

limits: This is a bounded filter-choice improvement, not full Sheets parity.
Saved and temporary filter views, color/relative-date filtering, charts, protection, undo, and broader visual/mobile coverage remain open.
